name: 姜黄格纹高腰娃娃领显高连衣裙款

shots.intent: 用鼠尾草绿拱形相框把街拍人像变成首屏点击钩子，一眼传递春日出行氛围与显瘦廓形。
shots.textZone: top hairline rule box with two small dot markers; headline block upper-left in #33302E, two lines reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」, small-caps Latin kicker above at 12pt in #7C8F7C

shots.intent: 把弧形褶皱高腰这一核心利益压缩成一秒可读的大字主张，替代参数罗列。
shots.textZone: headline centred in the lower sage panel at 40pt in #F7F5EF reading 「{selling_point_1}」, two body lines at 14pt in #F7F5EF reading 「{callout_1}」, small-caps Latin line beneath

shots.intent: 用同一身材同机位的两种轮廓对照，放大腰腹与腿型无处躲的日常尴尬。
shots.textZone: one label strip beneath each panel in #33302E at 14pt, left reading 「{callout_1}」 and right reading 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 仰拍全身把裙摆动势与显高比例交给真实街景，让买家代入春日出行场景。
把领口拼接与双层系带做成可验证的工艺证据，解释气质感从哪来。
shots.textZone: single label at the lower-left in #33302E at 12pt reading 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 90度俯视微距让纱线交点与格纹对花成为面料说服力的直接证据。
正侧90度交代袖口荷叶边与包边的立体量感，回应手臂线条顾虑。
shots.textZone: caption block bottom-right at 14pt in #33302E reading 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 同机位三格并列让买家在同一造型里比较搭配，中格去色制造节奏。
shots.textZone: one centred line inside the sage band at 14pt in #F7F5EF reading 「{callout_1}」, small-caps Latin kicker at 10pt above it

shots.intent: 用规整表格与圆形小图把选码这件最大的犹豫一次性收干。
shots.textZone: header line centred at 20pt in #33302E reading 「产品信息」, column labels at 12pt in #9CB49E, every data cell drawn as a neutral placeholder bar reading {callout_1} {callout_2} {callout_3} instead of numbers

shots.intent: 三栏细线点号条把面料体感落成可核对的短句，替资质话术做信任收口。
shots.textZone: three labels in #F7F5EF at 16pt reading 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」, each with a thin line rule ending in a dot and one small-caps Latin line at 10pt beneath

shots.intent: 用竖排字母侧栏把情绪与行动句压在收口位，替代促销贴图完成闭环。
shots.textZone: vertical letterspaced small-caps line in #F7F5EF at 24pt inside the sidebar reading {callout_1}, one action label at the foot of the sidebar at 14pt in #F7F5EF reading 「{callout_2}」

style.backgroundSystem: editorial fields alternating between flat sage green #9CB49E panels and paper off-white #F7F5EF margins, photographs masked into tall arches and rounded rectangles with thin hairline borders
style.iconSystem: thin single-line rules that terminate in one small solid dot; no filled icons, no illustrations, no badges
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused natural daylight around 5400K, front-side key from camera-left on graphic screens and side key on street screens, low-contrast wrap shadows, no hard flash, fabric kept readable with gentle raking relief
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium spring-street editorial apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper off-white #F7F5EF, sage green #9CB49E and deep charcoal #33302E with one product-matched accent color {accent_color} harmonised against the sage base; warm daylight tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with letterspaced small-caps Latin kicker lines, Chinese display copy wrapped in corner brackets; editorial layout alternating flat sage green #9CB49E panels with paper off-white #F7F5EF margins, photographs masked into arches and rounded rectangles with thin hairline borders; soft diffused natural daylight around 5400K, front-side key, low-contrast wrap shadows, no hard flash; thin single-line rules ending in a small dot as the only icon language; garment worn by a generic unrecognizable model, silhouette readable and never blocked by props, stable scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no store badges, membership offers or QR codes
style.presentationRules: garment always worn by a generic unrecognizable model with the face cropped or turned away, silhouette fully readable and never covered by props, same camera height and same scale across matched panels, plaid lines kept straight and unwarped
style.surfaceSystem: outdoor street facade in brick #A9583F with charcoal #33302E window frames and out-of-focus foliage; matte pavement #C9C2B6 as ground; matte paper as the graphic surface
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family: Chinese display headline in #33302E up to 40pt on paper or #F7F5EF on sage, letterspaced small-caps Latin kicker line in #7C8F7C at 10-12pt, body copy limited to two short lines
